Construct and Validate an IHE AIR (AI Results) Conformance Bundle

Source: R/ihe-ai.R
ihe_air_bundle.Rd

Packages a generated DICOM AI artifact (SEG or SR_TID1500) alongside a FHIR DiagnosticReport and W3C/FHIR Provenance record with model version and uncertainty metadata.

Usage

ihe_air_bundle(
  study_uid,
  model_name,
  model_version,
  dicom_artifact_type = c("SEG", "SR_TID1500"),
  dicom_sop_uid,
  fhir_report = list(),
  uncertainty_summary = list()
)

Arguments

study_uid

StudyInstanceUID string.

model_name

AI model name.

model_version

AI model semantic version string.

dicom_artifact_type

Either "SEG" or "SR_TID1500".

dicom_sop_uid

SOPInstanceUID of the generated DICOM AI object.

fhir_report

Named list of FHIR DiagnosticReport fields.

uncertainty_summary

Named list of model uncertainty metrics.

Value

An S3 "dicom_ihe_air_bundle" object.

Examples

air <- ihe_air_bundle(
  study_uid = "1.2.3.4",
  model_name = "TotalSegmentator",
  model_version = "2.4.0",
  dicom_artifact_type = "SEG",
  dicom_sop_uid = "1.2.3.99"
)
air$provenance$resourceType
#> [1] "Provenance"
